claims.subject: constellation-energy
claims.statement: Constellation announced on 20 September 2024 that it had signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft that would pave the way for restarting Three Mile Island Unit 1 as the Crane Clean Energy Center, with Microsoft purchasing energy from the plant as part of its goal to match the power its PJM data centers use with carbon-free energy.

time.note: Signing stated by Constellation in the release; the signature date itself is not given.

claims.qualification: Constellation's announcement of a signed agreement; the contract terms and price are not published. The restart required NRC approval (see cpo-pw-crane-nrc-fuel-amendment) and is not recorded as having occurred. The 835 MW figure is Constellation's wording for energy added to the grid, not a contracted delivery volume; the 2028 online date is a 2024 projection, later restated by Constellation as 2027 (cpo-pw-crane-nrc-fuel-amendment).
